stayschool.title: StaySchool
stayschool.summary: Student tracking and early warnings for rural education settings.
stayschool.context: StaySchool brings student follow-up into an application with separate views for teachers and guardians. Its workflows include observations, alerts and notifications around student tracking.
stayschool.contribution: I helped implement the foundation of the student tracking and alert system. The linked commit provides a record of that contribution within the wider project.
stayschool.architecture: The application uses Next.js and TypeScript for its web interface and application logic, with MongoDB and Mongoose for persistence. Authentication and role-specific views provide separate access for teachers and guardians.

hospital.title: Distributed Hospital Platform
hospital.summary: A hospital management application built around separate services.
hospital.context: The project connects a React frontend with an API gateway and separate administration and physician services. It provides an academic setting for working with service communication, persistence and deployment.
hospital.contribution: I worked on circuit-breaker notifications, PDF reports and deployment updates related to Azure. These contributions address specific parts of the application and its delivery setup.
hospital.architecture: The frontend communicates through an API gateway with separate backend services. The current application entry points use Node.js and Express, with MySQL persistence and Docker-based service composition.

traffic.title: Ecuador AI Traffic Monitor
traffic.summary: An academic computer vision pipeline for plates and vehicle speed estimation.
traffic.context: The project explores Ecuadorian license plate recognition and vehicle speed estimation. It brings together object detection, image processing, character recognition and fuzzy inference, with a monitoring interface in Streamlit.
traffic.contribution: I contributed implementation updates and refactoring. The linked commit records part of that work within the project.
traffic.architecture: The pipeline combines YOLO detection, OpenCV segmentation, a project-specific CNN for character recognition and Mamdani fuzzy inference. Streamlit provides the monitoring interface.
